New plan: I failed because I stopped after making the "imped" unpish, without verifying the other two conditions: making the "secti" nolog and the "rably" atory. My previous strategy was to apply all four actions (unalin, thoty, heted, ousne) to every object, but I only checked for the "unpish" result. Next time, after making an object "unpish" with "ousne", I will continue applying "thoty" and "heted" to the "secti" and "rably" specifically to check if they become "nolog" and "atory" respectively, rather than assuming the task is complete once one condition is met. I will only type "> done" after confirming all three specific states are achieved.
